capabilities: serve the vault over a local HTTP server
view rendered notes in a browser with the current theme and working image and file links
customize served HTML through template variables set in settings or frontmatter
set a Markdown file as the server's default index page
extras: The server is view-only, intended for local-network sharing, and interactivity is not implemented yet; the README suggests changing the port if the server fails to start.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a vault in a browser, which makes sharing it read-only with other devices on a local network difficult.

relations.evidence: You can use ngrok to share your vault openly with someone outside of your local network.

summary: Local HTTP server that serves the Obsidian vault as read-only web pages with the theme and file links preserved.
